subject: Shadowflow — Post-incident accountability, corrective actions & OKR alignment
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@shadowflow.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@shadowflow.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production degradation this morning — immediate help needed

Jordan —

Thanks for jumping on the bridge earlier. Brief summary from our side: starting ~02:40 PDT we saw a spike in inference latency to 2.6s p95 and a concurrent error-rate bump (5xx) up to 1.8% for our chat completion flows. Throughput also dipped because we began queueing requests on our side to avoid downstream failures. This is customer-impacting: a number of paying users reported timeouts.

We need a clear remediation timeline and an RCA that we can show leadership at Shadowflow. Can your team commit to a delivery plan and a public-facing summary by end of week?

Alicia
VP Product, Shadowflow

---
Attachment: grafana_screenshots.png (image/png) — three panels showing latency/error spike

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@shadowflow.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production degradation this morning — immediate help needed

Alicia — thanks for the concise summary and for surfacing those graphs. Apologies again for the disruption. High level from our on-call and infra teams: we observed a correlated increase in KV-cache misses following a rollout of a kernel selection tweak in the serving runtime. That caused heavier tail compute (longer sequences hitting unoptimized code-path) and increased queuing which pushed error rate up under load.

Immediate actions taken:
- Rolled back the kernel tweak at 03:15 PDT.
- Temporarily increased autoscaler headroom for the Shadowflow pool.
- Disabled aggressive batching for affected routes as a stop-gap.

Next steps we are committing to this week:
1) Formal RCA doc and timeline for permanent fix (by Thu EOD).
2) Mitigation checklist and config recommendations you can apply (by Wed).
3) A joint post-incident call with your ops+product + our engineering leadership (preferred Fri 10am PT) to walk through RCA and verify acceptance criteria.

I'll share the internal RCA draft with you by Thursday; we'll prepare a redacted version suitable for your leadership.

— Jordan
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Shadowflow outage — draft RCA outline and owners

Team — internal notes / please treat as working draft for Thursday: 

Root cause hypothesis:
- A kernel-selection optimization (PR #7118) altered prioritization for long-sequence execution paths. Under Shadowflow's traffic distribution (spike in long-context sessions), this increased on-device compute time and revealed a race where KV-cache invalidation occurred concurrently with read-paths.
- Result: increased cache misses => higher compute per request => queueing => transient 5xx and p95 latency spike.

Proposed fixes & owners:
- Immediate patch to guard the cache invalidation path (owner: Karthik Iyer) — short-term fix + unit tests.
- Re-run kernel selection A/B with synthetic long-context traffic (owner: Neha Kapoor) — validation before re-roll.
- Autoscaler tuning and safer default batching window for Shadowflow pool (owner: Laura Bennett) — config change, backward-compatible.
- Customer-facing summary + mitigation checklist (owner: Jordan Blake) — delivery Thu.

Verification criteria: p95 latency <= 350ms and 5xx < 0.1% for a 48h synthetic replay matching Shadowflow production distribution.

Please add any edits inline. We need the patch merged by Wed morning to be able to redeploy and observe through day.

— Laura
VP Engineering, Customer Reliability

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 07:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Shadowflow outage — draft RCA outline and owners

Laura/Jordan — quick status:
- Patch (guard + strict ordering on cache invalidation) is coded, integration tests added. PR #7242 opened, requesting expedited review.
- Also added histogram logging to KV layer to capture pre/post invalidation latencies for the canary.
- Plan: merge Wed 11:00, canary deploy Wed 13:00 PT to Shadowflow pool only.

Risks and mitigation: if canary shows increased CPU due to stricter locking we will scale the pool and revert locking granularity incrementally while we iterate on a lock-free approach.

Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer — Serving Runtime

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@shadowflow.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@shadowflow.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Shadowflow — RCA draft and proposed corrective actions

Alicia / Tom — attaching a draft RCA and an action checklist for your review. Summary for leadership:

Executive summary (redacted):
- Incident window: 2027-08-16 02:40–03:25 PDT.
- Impact: elevated p95 latency (to 2.6s) and brief 5xx increase (peak 1.8%) on chat completion endpoints; throughput degradation due to queuing.
- Root cause: a serving-runtime kernel-selection change interacted with KV-cache invalidation under Shadowflow's long-context workload; this caused cache churn and heavier compute per token.
- Immediate remediation: rollback of kernel tweak, autoscaler headroom, temporary batching changes.
- Permanent actions: guard and reorder cache invalidation (PR #7242), stricter canary gating for kernel rollouts, autoscaler policy changes for pools with long-context tails, monitoring and regression alerts tied to sequence-length distribution.

Ask: please confirm you want the redacted RCA formatted for your leadership deck (one-pager) or if you prefer a joint readout where we walk through the technical appendix.

Proposed joint meeting: Fri 20 Aug 2027, 10:00–10:45 PT (Zoom link in related_links). If that works I'll send an invite.

Best — Jordan
Director, Customer Reliability

Jordan / Laura — thanks for the thorough write-up and for the responsiveness. Shadowflow leadership reviewed the redacted RCA and the appended checklist; two notes:

1) We appreciate the canary + gating add — please include in the public summary the specific rollback criteria you used during the incident (so our security/compliance team can sign off).
2) We'll accept the one-pager for exec review but request a follow-up 30-day validation report showing the synthetic-replay results and the p95/5xx trend.

We can confirm Fri 20 Aug 10:00 PT for the joint readout (moved due to scheduling to 10:15 — meeting invite forthcoming).

Tom
Head of Infrastructure — Shadowflow
